Blood Cleaner trailer | Foxxyy Studio
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Play the game here: https://foxxyystudio.itch.io/blood-cleaner
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
In Blood Cleaner, you’re Amaan, a cleaner hired to tidy up an old mansion. But as eerie clues and bloodstains emerge, you’re left wondering—was there a crime, or is something haunting these walls? Clean up…or get caught in the mess.
